name: La Paz / El Alto
why: Seat of government, 3,650 m; Bolivia's main gateway hub (El Alto airport, cable cars, Death Road, Tiwanaku)

name: Copacabana (Lake Titicaca)
why: Lakeside pilgrimage town, base for Isla del Sol and the Peru border (Kasani/Yunguyo)

name: Isla del Sol
why: Titicaca island with Inca sites and a north-south hike; boats from Copacabana

name: Coroico (Yungas)
why: Subtropical Yungas town; La Paz-Coroico is usually done as a day trip or short stay (bushop)

name: Oruro
why: Carnival city and rail/bus junction between La Paz, Uyuni and Cochabamba (Sajama NP base)

name: Uyuni (Salar de Uyuni)
why: Gateway to the world's largest salt flat; mirror effect forms Dec-Mar; Incahuasi usually closed Jan-Mar

name: Potosi
why: 4,000 m UNESCO silver-mining city (Cerro Rico tours); on the Sucre-Uyuni-La Paz corridor

name: Sucre
why: Constitutional capital, white colonial city, mild climate; Tarabuco and dinosaur footprints nearby

name: Tupiza
why: Red-canyon town in the south, starting point for Uyuni 4x4 tours and Villazon (Argentina) border

name: Cochabamba
why: Third-largest city, food capital, Cristo de la Concordia; road/air hub between altiplano and lowlands

name: Santa Cruz de la Sierra
why: Largest city and international airport (Viru Viru); gateway to Samaipata, Chiquitania and Amazon-side flights

name: Samaipata
why: Cool hill-town with El Fuerte (UNESCO) and Amboro NP; weekend retreat from Santa Cruz

name: Rurrenabaque (Madidi)
why: Amazon-edge jungle and pampas tour base for Madidi NP; flights and roads disrupted in rainy season (peak Jan-Feb)

name: Puno (Peru, reference)
why: Peruvian Titicaca port and transfer point for Copacabana; nearest airport Juliaca (JUL) about 1 h

name: Cusco (Peru, reference)
why: Machu Picchu gateway; tourist bus to La Paz (12-14 h) and Avianca flight CUZ-LPB

name: Lima (Peru, reference)
why: Peru's hub; direct flights to La Paz and Santa Cruz (BoA, LATAM)

name: Bogota (Colombia, reference)
why: Colombian hub; Avianca nonstops to La Paz and Santa Cruz; Viva/Volaris/Aeromexico/Copa from Guadalajara

name: Panama City (reference)
why: Copa hub; GDL and Santa Cruz both connect here

name: San Jose (Costa Rica, reference)
why: Central America entry; Volaris Costa Rica / Aeromexico / Copa from Guadalajara

name: Guatemala City (reference)
why: Gateway to Antigua; Volaris GDL-GUA resumes 4 Dec 2026

name: Guadalajara
why: Jalisco capital and Mexico's second-largest hub; base for Tequila, Chapala, Guanajuato, Vallarta

name: Tequila
why: Agave landscape UNESCO town; tequila distillery tours; day trip from Guadalajara

name: Guanajuato
why: Colorful UNESCO colonial city (Bajio airport BJX near Leon about 0.5 h); about 4 h from Guadalajara

name: Lake Chapala / Ajijic
why: Lake Chapala and expat town Ajijic; day trip from Guadalajara by Chapala Plus bus

name: Puerto Vallarta
why: Pacific resort and beach hub; flights and ETN/Primera Plus buses from Guadalajara

name: Drake Bay (Osa Peninsula)
why: Remote Osa Peninsula base for Corcovado wildlife and Isla del Caño shark dives

name: Guatemala City
why: Capital, La Aurora airport and the hub for buses to Flores, Lanquin, El Salvador and Honduras

name: Antigua Guatemala
why: Colonial town and the main backpacker base with the densest shuttle network in Guatemala

name: Lake Atitlan (Panajachel / San Pedro)
why: Volcano lake with Panajachel gateway and San Pedro / San Marcos / San Juan villages reached by lancha

name: Quetzaltenango (Xela)
why: Highland city, Spanish schools, volcano hikes, route to Mexico border

name: Flores / Tikal
why: Island town at Lake Peten Itza, gateway to Tikal and the Belize border (San Ignacio)

name: Lanquin / Semuc Champey
why: Turquoise pools and caves in Alta Verapaz, backpacker staple

name: San Salvador
why: Capital and transport hub; Tica Bus terminal; SAL airport about 45 km away

name: El Tunco / El Zonte coast
why: Surf and backpacker beach town on the Pacific coast, about 1 h from SAL airport

name: Copan Ruinas
why: Maya ruins town just over the Guatemala border at El Florido; shuttle crossing point

name: San Pedro Sula
why: Honduras' commercial hub and international airport; bus gateway to La Ceiba and Tegucigalpa

name: Tegucigalpa
why: Honduran capital, on the Tica Bus / Pullmantur line between San Salvador and Managua

name: La Ceiba
why: North coast port town; ferry terminals to Roatan and Utila, Pico Bonito, rafting

name: Roatan
why: Largest Bay Island: West End and West Bay, diving and beaches

name: Utila
why: Cheapest diving in the Caribbean, backpacker island with no scheduled flights

name: Managua
why: Capital and hub for all Nicaraguan buses, shuttles and the Corn Islands flights

name: Leon
why: Colonial university city, volcano boarding, Pacific beaches

name: Granada
why: Colonial city on Lake Nicaragua; base for Masaya, Mombacho and Ometepe

name: San Juan del Sur
why: Surf and party beach town, 30 km from the Costa Rica border

name: Ometepe
why: Twin-volcano island in Lake Nicaragua, ferry from San Jorge to Moyogalpa

name: Big Corn Island
why: Caribbean island with La Costena flights from MGA; gateway to Little Corn

name: Little Corn Island
why: Car-free Caribbean island reached by panga from Big Corn

name: San Jose (Costa Rica)
why: Transit node: Tica Bus / Transnica terminals and SJO airport with flights to Colombia and Mexico

name: Liberia (Costa Rica)
why: Northwest Costa Rica airport and bus hub, 3 h from San Juan del Sur by shuttle

name: Panama City
why: Copa hub with flights to Colombia, jump-off for San Blas and Puerto Obaldia routes

name: San Blas / Guna Yala
why: Guna Yala island chain; the standard Panama to Colombia sailing or speedboat route

name: Capurgana (Colombia, Darien coast)
why: Colombian arrival point from Puerto Obaldia, Sapzurro and the San Blas speedboat tours

name: Bogota
why: Capital and main air hub; flights to every Colombian node plus Panama, Central America and Bolivia

name: Medellin
why: Most popular backpacker city; second air hub (JMC airport 45 min out, Olaya Herrera EOH for Clic/Satena)

name: Cali
why: Salsa capital in the south; air link to Caribbean coast and San Andres

name: Cartagena
why: Walled colonial city, top Caribbean destination and Panama flight/boat gateway

name: Santa Marta
why: Gateway to Tayrona, Minca, Palomino and the Sierra Nevada

name: Pereira
why: Coffee region air and bus hub for Salento, Manizales and Cocora

name: San Andres
why: Caribbean island, direct flights from most Colombian cities and Panama

name: Providencia
why: Quiet island reached only by Satena flight or ferry from San Andres

name: Salento (Valle de Cocora)
why: Coffee-region village and gateway to Valle de Cocora wax palms

name: Manizales
why: Coffee-region city near Los Nevados; La Nubia airport has Clic flights

name: Guatape
why: Lake town and El Penol rock, standard Medellin day trip (about 2 h)

name: Tayrona National Park
why: Top Caribbean beach park, entrances El Zaino, Calabazo, Palangana, Bahia Concha

name: Palomino
why: Backpacker beach town with river tubing, on the coast road east of Tayrona

name: Minca
why: Cloud-forest village above Santa Marta, hostels and coffee farms

name: Barranquilla
why: Transfer city between Cartagena and Santa Marta, airport with Avianca/LATAM/Wingo/JetSmart

name: San Gil (and Barichara)
why: Adventure sports capital of Santander, base for Barichara and Chicamocha

name: Villa de Leyva
why: Colonial town 3-4 h from Bogota

name: Necocli
why: Gulf of Uraba port where boats leave for Capurgana (main route toward Panama)

name: Capurgana
why: Car-free Caribbean beach town near the Panama border (airstrip CPB charters)

name: Sapzurro
why: Bay village 10-15 min by boat from Capurgana; trail up to the La Miel border post

name: Puerto Obaldia
why: Panamanian border town with immigration; Air Panama flights to Panama City

name: Panama City
why: Copa hub; nearest big neighbour region to Colombia by air

name: San Salvador
why: Central America link from Bogota (Avianca nonstop)

name: San Jose (Costa Rica)
why: Central America link from Bogota and Cartagena (Avianca Costa Rica, Copa)

name: La Paz
why: Bolivia link: Avianca nonstop from Bogota

name: Santa Cruz de la Sierra
why: Bolivia link: Avianca nonstop from Bogota, Copa from Panama

name: Cancún
why: Caribbean gateway with cheap flights to Europe, Mexico, Central America and Colombia

name: Mexico City
why: Capital and Mexico's biggest hub (MEX, plus NLU Felipe Ángeles 45 km north)

name: Playa del Carmen
why: Riviera Maya beach town, 1 h from Cancún airport; base for Cozumel and bull shark dives
